_note: Audit part 2 recheck (November 2026): second-checked fixes from the random 600-stage recheck; stage places are those after stage_fix_zaudit.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4
edit.text: Sunil Bakshi uses a Photostatic Veil to pose as Glenn Talbot and trick Coulson's team.
edit.whoA: Hydra agent who impersonates Talbot to trick Coulson's team.
edit.whoB: General Bakshi impersonates to trick Coulson's team.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#11
add.text: Once Bakshi is caught, Coulson trades him to Talbot, who wants him for Hydra's attacks and for posing as him.
add.whoA: Hydra agent Coulson hands over to Talbot.
add.whoB: The general Coulson hands Bakshi over to.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#14
add.text: Ward and Agent 33 break into Talbot's base and kidnap Bakshi from his cell.
add.whoA: Hydra prisoner kidnapped from Talbot's base.
add.whoB: The general from whose base Bakshi is kidnapped.

edit.whoB: A veteran agent Coulson trusts, with a team he hires. She dies on his mission.

edit.text: Lucian stabs Stephen Strange in the New York Sanctum and follows his astral form to a hospital, where Strange kills him.
edit.whoB: A Zealot who tries to kill Strange. Strange kills him in an astral fight.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
edit.text: Kora learns that Nathaniel killed her mother, Jiaying, and begins to doubt him. When she lets Daisy go, he shoots her and has her locked up.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
add.text: Nathaniel drains Kora's powers into himself while she is held. Once freed, Kora helps S.H.I.E.L.D. stop the Chronicoms and saves Daisy's life.
add.whoA: Steals Kora's powers after she turns on him.
add.whoB: Turns on Nathaniel, who steals her powers, and sides with S.H.I.E.L.D. against him.

edit.text: Jean Grey, a telepath attacking Damage Control, takes control of Frank when he joins Spider-Man to stop her. Frank later shoots at her from a distance, and Spider-Man shields her.
edit.whoA: A telepath who takes control of Frank. He later shoots at her.
edit.whoB: A vigilante who joins Spider-Man against Jean, falls under her control, and later shoots at her.

edit.title: What If...?#6
edit.text: Pepper suspects Killmonger in Tony's and Rhodey's deaths. Shuri brings her proof, and the two team up to expose him.
edit.whoA: Doubts Killmonger and teams up with Shuri to expose him.

add.title: What If...?#9
add.text: Pepper and Shuri storm the throne room in Wakanda to bring Killmonger down, but he is already gone.
add.whoA: Storms Killmonger's throne room with Shuri to bring him down.
add.whoB: Killed Tony. Pepper storms his throne room to bring him down.

edit.text: Jemma has saved May's life before, curing her after a ghost's touch nearly kills her. When Sarge fatally stabs May, Jemma injects her with a healing formula and freezes her in a cryo chamber to keep her alive.

After Peggy Carter kidnaps Rufus Hunt, she and Daniel Sousa interrogate him in secret, and he mocks Daniel's missing leg. Tricked into thinking he has malaria, Hunt gives up Council names, and Daniel lets him escape with a bug on him.

edit.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#17
edit.text: In Russia, Storm whips up a blizzard to freeze Omega Red solid.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#47
add.text: Omega Red agrees to salvage a sinking Russian submarine only if Storm and Wolverine dive with him, and Storm goes down with him.
add.whoA: Makes Storm dive with him to a sinking submarine.
add.whoB: Dives with Omega Red to a sinking submarine.

edit.text: Benjamin Poindexter, the hitman Bullseye, hunts Karen for Fisk. Dressed as Daredevil, he attacks Clinton Church to kill her, but she knocks him off a balcony.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#23
edit.text: Terri Lee teams with Blade and Spider-Man against Morbius and falls for Blade, but they decide a relationship would be too dangerous. Blade kisses her before he rides away.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#48
add.text: Terri and Blade still love each other, and she helps fight his mother, Miriam. They share one last kiss before he leaves to hunt Miriam.
add.whoA: The vampire hunter Terri loves, who leaves to hunt his mother.
add.whoB: The detective who loves Blade and kisses him goodbye.

edit.text: After Sylvie unlocks her memories, B-15 turns against Renslayer and frees Loki and Sylvie in the Time-Keepers' chamber. Renslayer orders her pruned on sight, and the Minutemen knock her out.
edit.whoB: Loyal Hunter turned traitor, whom Renslayer orders pruned.

edit.text: After Sylvie unlocks her memories, B-15 turns against Renslayer and frees Loki and Sylvie in the Time-Keepers' chamber. Renslayer orders her pruned on sight, and the Minutemen knock her out.
edit.whoB: Loyal Hunter turned traitor, whom Renslayer orders pruned.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#11
edit.text: Doctor Octopus breaks himself and the other villains out of Ryker's Island and forms the Sinister Six to kill Spider-Man.
edit.whoA: The hero Otto builds the Sinister Six to kill.
edit.whoB: Mastermind of the Sinister Six, built to kill Peter.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#23
add.text: As the Master Planner, Doctor Octopus plots against Spider-Man from a hidden lair. In the Valentine's Day gang war, Spider-Man subdues him, and he is arrested.
add.whoA: The hero who foils Otto's plots and has him arrested.
add.whoB: The Master Planner, whom Peter subdues in the gang war.

edit.text: Thanos is Nebula's adoptive father, and she grows to hate him for what he has turned her into. When Ronan vows to kill Thanos, she pledges to help Ronan.
edit.whoA: Nebula's adoptive father, whom she hates for what he made her.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
edit.text: Disguised as a soldier, Lance Hunter helps S.H.I.E.L.D. kidnap General Glenn Talbot after May and Skye save Talbot from Carl Creel.
edit.whoA: Mercenary who helps kidnap Talbot.
edit.whoB: General Hunter helps kidnap.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
add.text: Talbot, a fan of Hunter's army record, offers him money and a proper burial for Isabelle Hartley to betray Coulson.
add.whoA: Mercenary whom Talbot tries to bribe into betraying Coulson.
add.whoB: General who tries to bribe Hunter into betraying Coulson.

edit.text: Gideon Malick's Hydra captures Jemma and Fitz and brings them to its castle, because he wants to know how she made it back from the planet Maveth. Hydra tortures Jemma until Fitz agrees to go through the portal to bring Hive to Earth.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#10
edit.text: Giyera, Malick's telekinetic Inhuman, floats a gun to shoot Daisy as she hacks into Hydra's systems at its castle. Joey melts the bullets and Lincoln knocks Giyera down.
edit.whoA: Malick's telekinetic Inhuman. Tries to shoot Daisy at the Hydra castle.
edit.whoB: An Inhuman Giyera tries to shoot as she hacks Hydra's castle.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
add.text: Now loyal to Hive, Giyera fights the Secret Warriors as they storm Hydra's base to retake Zephyr One, and Daisy knocks him out with a shockwave.
add.whoA: Hive's telekinetic follower. Daisy knocks him out with a shockwave.
add.whoB: Blasts Giyera with a shockwave and knocks him out.

edit.text: Director Jeffrey Mace leads the S.H.I.E.L.D. team that storms Eli Morrow's Chinatown Crew headquarters. He is reluctant to use Ghost Rider on the mission and insists that Robbie not be seen by the press.
Director Jeffrey Mace brings Holden Radcliffe in as a consultant, briefing him on Eli Morrow and handing him strange boxes that draw energy from the multiverse.
Nebula hunts Drax's friends across Knowhere on Ronan's orders. On the Dark Aster, Drax blasts her with a rocket launcher.
edit.whoA: Ronan's ally. Drax blasts her on the Dark Aster.
edit.whoB: One of the heroes who blasts Nebula on the Dark Aster.

edit.whoA: A scavenger from 2091 who recruits Mike to help save the Lighthouse.

edit.text: Raava replaces James Rhodes and impersonates him in the U.S. government. Fury eventually exposes and kills her.
edit.whoA: The Skrull who replaced Rhodes and wore his face.
edit.whoB: The man Raava replaced and impersonated.

edit.text: Carson Wolf is Dinah's superior at Homeland Security, and he orders her to drop her investigation into Ahmad Zubair's death.
edit.whoA: Wolf's subordinate at Homeland Security, whom he orders off the Zubair case.
edit.whoB: Madani's boss at Homeland Security, who orders her off the Zubair case.

edit.text: Ever since Tyrone absorbed O'Reilly's violent half, Mayhem, into his cloak during her rampage at a trafficking site, she has been trapped in the Dark Dimension. There she repays him, swapping the records Andre uses to manipulate him and spurring him to go find Tandy.

After Diamondback shoots Luke Cage with a Judas bullet while Luke walks with Claire, he flips the ambulance carrying them, then tracks them to the clinic where she is trying to dig the bullet out. When he grabs her through the window, Claire stabs him in the arm.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#11
edit.text: Gideon Malick secretly leads HYDRA, and his people kill Coulson's lover Rosalind Price. Coulson calls him and vows to bring down everything he has built, and Malick warns him not to get ahead of himself.
edit.whoA: Director who vows to bring Malick down after Hydra kills Rosalind.
edit.whoB: Secret Hydra head whose people kill Rosalind. Warns Coulson not to get ahead of himself.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
add.text: Coulson's Secret Warriors capture Malick at Hydra's base, and Coulson interrogates him at the Playground about Rosalind's murder and Hive.
add.whoA: Director who captures and interrogates Malick.
add.whoB: Hydra head Coulson captures and interrogates.

edit.text: Yondu's Ravagers capture Groot, then mutiny when Yondu will not hand Peter Quill over. Groot keeps fetching the wrong things from Yondu's quarters until Kraglin helps him bring back the prototype fin, and Yondu and Rocket break out.
edit.whoA: Ravager captain whom Groot, with Kraglin's help, frees by bringing his fin.
edit.whoB: Little Guardian who, with Kraglin's help, brings Yondu his prototype fin.

edit.title: Runaways S1–S2#14
edit.text: Topher follows Molly to the hostel, and she pleads for him to stay, hoping he might be family. Then Nico finds he lied about where his strength comes from.

Jeri Hogarth defends Hope Shlottman against a murder Kilgrave forced her to commit, then secretly cuts the wires holding him in check, hoping to use his power against her wife Wendy. After he escapes, he takes control of Jeri and turns Wendy against her.
edit.whoA: The killer Jeri hopes to use against Wendy, who turns on her.
edit.whoB: The lawyer who sabotages Kilgrave's cell, hoping to use him against her wife.

edit.text: The collider's destruction left Johnathon Ohnn covered in portals, and as the Spot he blames Miles for ruining his life and wants to be his great villain. He grows strong enough to threaten Miles's whole world.

When Sonny Burch exposes Hope van Dyne at his restaurant, Anitolov makes her sit for Burch's forced deal. When she comes back in her Wasp suit, he shoots at her, and she fights her way through him and the rest of Burch's men.
edit.whoB: A Burch henchman who shoots at Hope.

edit.text: Goose is Mar-Vell's pet Flerken and lives with her on Earth while she works undercover as Dr. Wendy Lawson.
edit.whoA: Goose's owner, who keeps her while working undercover on Earth.
edit.whoB: Mar-Vell's pet Flerken, who lives with her on Earth.

edit.text: Holden Radcliffe befriends Fitz, and the two secretly build the android Aida, the first new Life Model Decoy. Radcliffe then betrays S.H.I.E.L.D., and his Framework becomes the trap that holds Fitz's mind, where Fitz becomes the cruel Doctor.
edit.whoA: The friend Radcliffe builds Aida with, later trapped in Radcliffe's Framework.
edit.whoB: The friend Fitz builds Aida with, whose Framework later traps Fitz's mind.

edit.text: Piper and Yo-Yo keep Zephyr One flying while the team is trapped in the Framework. When the plane runs low on power, Piper suggests dropping the cloak, and Yo-Yo goes along with it.
Gargan leads the Scorpions against the 110th Street Gang and tries to impale Lonnie with his tail. Lonnie, newly super strong, fights him beside Spider-Man, then stops Spider-Man from killing him.
edit.whoB: The rival gang boss who tries to impale Lonnie with his tail.

edit.text: Jim Morita is freed from a HYDRA prison camp by Steve Rogers and joins the Howling Commandos under his command. He fights with Steve across Europe until Steve goes into the ice.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#9
edit.text: Tucker Shockley orders Jemma Simmons killed after she saves Vijay Nadeer from his Terrigenesis and comes asking questions at Senator Nadeer's office.
edit.whoA: A Watchdog who orders Jemma killed for saving Vijay.
edit.whoB: A scientist Shockley orders killed for saving Vijay Nadeer.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#13
add.text: Terrigen meant for Nadeer turns Shockley into an Inhuman who explodes and reforms. Simmons and Fitz trap his ashes in a device they built.
add.whoA: An Inhuman Watchdog whom Jemma and Fitz trap.
add.whoB: A scientist who helps trap Shockley.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#1
edit.text: Jeffrey Mace is S.H.I.E.L.D.'s new Director and Mack's boss. He orders Mack and Coulson off their hunt for Daisy, now the vigilante Quake.
edit.whoA: Mack's new Director, who orders him off the hunt for Daisy.
edit.whoB: An agent Mace orders off the hunt for Daisy.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#10
add.text: When the Watchdogs bring down Mace's Quinjet in Freyer National Park, Mack and Coulson take out the mercenaries sent to kill him.
add.whoA: Mack's Director, whom Mack saves from the Watchdogs' mercenaries.
add.whoB: An agent who saves Mace from the Watchdogs' mercenaries.

edit.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#8
edit.text: In the end Sheila breaks with Fisk, bringing him the offer to leave the city in exchange for not being prosecuted.
edit.whoA: Sheila's boss, whom she turns on by bringing him the offer to leave the city.
edit.whoB: Fisk's chief of staff, who turns on him by bringing him the offer to leave the city.

add.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
add.text: With Fisk gone from New York, Sheila takes over as the city's mayor.
add.whoA: Sheila's former boss, whom she succeeds as mayor.
add.whoB: Fisk's former chief of staff, who succeeds him as mayor.

edit.title: Daredevil S3#3
edit.text: Once the FBI frees Fisk, Karen digs into his deals to put him back in prison.
edit.whoA: The freed crime lord Karen digs into.
edit.whoB: The woman who digs into Fisk's deals after his release.

add.title: Daredevil S3#8
add.text: Karen confronts Fisk and taunts him with the truth that she killed Wesley.
add.whoA: The crime lord Karen taunts with the truth about Wesley.
add.whoB: The woman who taunts Fisk that she killed Wesley.

add.title: Daredevil S3#10
add.text: Fisk sends Poindexter to Clinton Church to kill Karen.
add.whoA: The crime lord who sends Poindexter to kill Karen.
add.whoB: The woman Fisk sends Poindexter to kill.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
edit.text: Montana and the Enforcers, hired by the Big Man to kill Spider-Man, attack him while he fights the Vulture. Spider-Man beats the others, but Montana escapes.
edit.whoA: The hero Montana is hired to kill.
edit.whoB: An Enforcer hired to kill Peter.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#4
add.text: Montana fights Spider-Man as the Shocker in a trap at a landfill and knocks him into a machine, leaving him for dead.
add.whoA: The hero Montana tries to kill as the Shocker.
add.whoB: An Enforcer who attacks Peter at a landfill as the Shocker.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#22
add.text: Montana fights Spider-Man again as the Shocker alongside the new Enforcers, whom the Tinkerer has armed with new gear.
add.whoA: Beats Montana again and again.
add.whoB: Fights Peter again with the new Enforcers.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
edit.text: Davis serves under Mack once Mack becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
edit.whoA: An agent under Mack's command.
edit.whoB: Davis's Director.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
add.text: Izel possesses Davis to get inside the Lighthouse, then drops him from a ledge and kills him before jumping into Mack.
add.whoA: An agent under Mack's command, until Izel possesses and kills Davis.
add.whoB: Davis's Director, until Izel possesses and kills Davis.

edit.title: Runaways S1–S2#1
edit.text: Janet Stein is having a long, secret affair with Robert Minoru.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#6
add.text: Victor exposes Janet's affair with Robert Minoru in public at the PRIDE gala.
add.whoA: Janet's lover. Victor exposes their affair at the gala.
add.whoB: Robert's lover. Victor exposes their affair at the gala.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#2
edit.text: Jason Wilkes and Whitney Frost fight over Isodyne's Zero Matter, and both are exposed to it in the struggle.
edit.whoA: The woman Wilkes fights over Isodyne's Zero Matter.
edit.whoB: The Isodyne scientist Whitney fights over the Zero Matter.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#7
add.text: Whitney Frost breaks into Howard Stark's estate and kidnaps Jason Wilkes to use in her Zero Matter experiments.
add.whoA: The woman who kidnaps Wilkes for her Zero Matter experiments.
add.whoB: The scientist Whitney kidnaps to help with her Zero Matter work.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#8
add.text: Whitney Frost talks Wilkes into helping her reopen the rift with an atomic test. When it opens, it is Wilkes, not Frost, who absorbs the extra Zero Matter.
add.whoA: The woman whose rift test fills Wilkes with Zero Matter.
add.whoB: The scientist who absorbs the Zero Matter Whitney wanted from the rift.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#4
edit.text: Rio Vidal is summoned as the coven's new Green Witch and walks the Witches' Road with Jennifer Kale.
edit.whoA: The coven's Green Witch on the Road.
edit.whoB: A witch Rio walks the Road with.

add.title: Agatha All Along#7
add.text: Lilia discovers that Rio, the coven's Green Witch, is Death, and tells Jen and the others.
add.whoA: The coven's Green Witch on the Road, who turns out to be Death.
add.whoB: A witch Rio walks the Road with, who learns Rio is Death.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#5
edit.text: Lucy Bauer, Eli Morrow's former colleague at Momentum Labs, kidnaps him during the South Ridge prison riot and forces him to read the Darkhold for her.
edit.whoA: A former Momentum colleague who takes Eli hostage.
edit.whoB: A former Momentum colleague Lucy takes hostage.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#6
add.text: Lucy reveals that Eli betrayed her at Momentum Labs, locking her in the experiment that turned her into a ghost.
add.whoA: Former Momentum colleague Eli made a ghost. Takes him hostage.
add.whoB: Former Momentum colleague who made Lucy a ghost. She takes him hostage.

edit.text: Jemma Simmons wakes Piper at gunpoint during Aida's takeover and shows her she is not a decoy. Piper helps get the agents out of the Playground before it is blown up.
edit.whoA: An agent Jemma wakes and gets out of the Playground before it falls.

edit.text: Casey files the Tesseract taken from Loki as evidence. When Loki threatens to kill him for it, Casey hands it over, and Loki finds a drawer of Infinity Stones that Casey says some workers use as paperweights.
edit.whoA: A variant who threatens Casey for the Tesseract and finds the drawer of Infinity Stones.
edit.whoB: The TVA clerk who hands over the Tesseract and says Infinity Stones serve as paperweights.

edit.text: Doctor Octopus and the Scorpion are both members of the Insidious Six, the team Kingpin breaks out of prison to destroy Spider-Man.
edit.whoA: A fellow member of Kingpin's Insidious Six.
edit.whoB: A fellow member of Kingpin's Insidious Six.

edit.text: Ayo guards the royal family at T'Challa's coronation and points her spear at M'Baku when he steps menacingly toward Shuri, before he challenges T'Challa for the throne. In the final battle, M'Baku's Jabari arrive to save Ayo, Shuri, Nakia and Okoye from the Border Tribe, and they fight on the same side.
edit.whoA: The Jabari leader Ayo holds at spear point, whose warriors later save her in battle.
edit.whoB: A Dora Milaje who points her spear at M'Baku, then fights on his side against Killmonger.

edit.text: Karl Malus is the IGH doctor who saved Jessica's life and gave her powers through experiments. After she hunts him down, Trish forces him to experiment on her, and when Jessica stops it, Malus sets his lab on fire with himself inside.
edit.whoB: The woman Malus saved and gave powers, who stops his experiment on Trish.
